generationInputs.prompt: A cartoon vintage 3D snark poster features a luminous pink donut, an eggplant, two bananas, and a red and green chili pepper, all depicted with a playful, edgy humor. The central focus is a luminous pink donut, seemingly weightless, from which two female legs in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes emerge. Two hands also extend from the donut, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other a glass pipe. A dark pink background softly complements the donut's color, giving it a delicate and ethereal beauty. To the side, an eggplant is depicted holding a syringe. Next to it, two bananas are present, one holding a bright syringe, and the other alongside a red chili pepper and a green chili pepper. The overall image has a dreamlike and slightly otherworldly quality due to the holographic effect of the donut's icing.
